# Tui Media

> Tui Media is a one-person video studio in Nelson, New Zealand, run by Arlo Radford. It makes monthly video content for builders, landscapers and the trades around them, as well as joiners, kitchen and bathroom companies and other local businesses across Nelson, Richmond, Motueka, Tasman and Marlborough. Weddings, events and other films are at arloradford.nz. Contact: hello@tuimedia.nz.

## Services

- [Monthly content](https://www.tuimedia.nz/monthly-content): one or two shoots a month on your jobs, then finished videos and photos ready to post. Lite $450 a month (2 videos, 10 photos, 1 shoot), Core $900 (4 videos, 20 photos, 2 shoots), Full $1,500 (8 videos, 30 photos, 2 shoots). Every plan has a plan and shot list before each shoot and a monthly check-in. Month to month with 14 days' notice.
- [Testimonial films](https://www.tuimedia.nz/testimonial-films): a short film of one of your customers talking about the job you did for them. $1,000 for the first film, then $750 each, or $650 each when two are filmed on the same day. Always $650 on monthly content. Six months to film them, paid as each one is shot.

## About

- [About Tui Media](https://www.tuimedia.nz/about): a small Nelson studio. Over thirty Nelson businesses have used it, including builders, landscapers, car detailers, a wildlife sanctuary and the Nelson Marlborough Rescue Helicopter Trust.
- [Home](https://www.tuimedia.nz/): overview, how it works, client reviews (5.0 from 14 Google reviews) and FAQs.
- Book a free 20 minute call: https://www.tuimedia.nz/#book
